parsed.note_claim: Numerous fact checks debunked the claims that Chelsea Clinton received USAID money.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In short, Chelsea Clinton has not received $84 million from USAID. The graph shared purporting to show how money flows to "Bill Hillary & Chelsea Clinton" is a reference to the Bill, Hillary & Chelsea Clinton Foundation, not Chelsea Clinton specifically.
parsed.reason: The Snopes fact check directly debunks the claim that Chelsea Clinton received USAID money, rating it False and providing evidence that she received no personal funds from USAID.
